OtherNames: Summit Lake LNG; Summit Lake PG LNG Project
Location: Hart Industrial site, approx. 30 km north of Prince George (about 11 km south of Summit Lake), British Columbia
ResearcherNotesProject: Inland LNG plant; LNG railed ~10 km new track to existing rail network then to BC west coast (Prince Rupert) in ISO containers for export to Asia, avoiding a long pipeline. ~200,000 m3 LNG storage. Registered with the Impact Assessment Agency of Canada (project 87307) and BC EAO on 2024-02-12; IAAC timeline suspended 2024-06-28 at proponent's request (158 of 180 planning-phase days elapsed) — assessment paused, project not withdrawn. 30-year operating life. JX LNG Canada Ltd is an Alberta-registered subsidiary of Changchun Jixing New Energy Ltd (NE China). Proposed status retained despite the assessment suspension.
